defmodule SecureTransport.FrameParser do
  @moduledoc """
  Parses incoming network frames with strict validation.
  All frame sizes are validated against protocol limits.
  Buffer allocations are bounded and checked.
  """

  @max_frame_size 4096
  @header_size 8
  @max_payload_size @max_frame_size - @header_size
  @supported_versions [1, 2, 3]

  defstruct [:version, :msg_type, :flags, :payload_length, :payload, :checksum]

  @doc """
  Parse a raw binary frame from the network.
  Returns {:ok, frame} or {:error, reason}.
  """
  def parse_frame(<<version::unsigned-8, msg_type::unsigned-8, flags::unsigned-8,
                    _reserved::unsigned-8, payload_length::unsigned-big-16,
                    checksum::unsigned-big-16, rest::binary>>) do
    with :ok <- validate_version(version),
         :ok <- validate_msg_type(msg_type),
         :ok <- validate_payload_length(payload_length),
         :ok <- validate_available_data(rest, payload_length) do
      <<payload::binary-size(payload_length), _trailing::binary>> = rest
      frame = %__MODULE__{
        version: version,
        msg_type: msg_type,
        flags: flags,
        payload_length: payload_length,
        payload: payload,
        checksum: checksum
      }
      case verify_checksum(frame) do
        :ok -> {:ok, frame}
        {:error, _} = err -> err
      end
    end
  end

  def parse_frame(_), do: {:error, :malformed_header}

  defp validate_version(v) when v in @supported_versions, do: :ok
  defp validate_version(_), do: {:error, :unsupported_version}

  defp validate_msg_type(t) when t >= 0 and t <= 15, do: :ok
  defp validate_msg_type(_), do: {:error, :invalid_msg_type}

  # Validates that payload_length does not exceed maximum.
  # This prevents buffer overallocation attacks.
  defp validate_payload_length(len) when len > @max_payload_size do
    {:error, :payload_too_large}
  end
  defp validate_payload_length(_len), do: :ok

  defp validate_available_data(data, required) when byte_size(data) >= required, do: :ok
  defp validate_available_data(_, _), do: {:error, :insufficient_data}

  defp verify_checksum(%__MODULE__{payload: payload, checksum: expected}) do
    computed = :erlang.crc32(payload) |> Bitwise.band(0xFFFF)
    if computed == expected, do: :ok, else: {:error, :checksum_mismatch}
  end

  @doc """
  Process a parsed frame by dispatching to the appropriate handler.
  Allocates a response buffer based on the frame's payload_length field.
  """
  def process_frame(%__MODULE__{} = frame) do
    # Response buffer is payload_length + 1 for null terminator in NIF
    response_buf_size = frame.payload_length + 1
    
    case frame.msg_type do
      0 -> handle_ping(frame, response_buf_size)
      1 -> handle_data(frame, response_buf_size)
      2 -> handle_control(frame, response_buf_size)
      _ -> handle_generic(frame, response_buf_size)
    end
  end

  defp handle_ping(%__MODULE__{payload: payload}, buf_size) do
    # Echo back with allocated buffer
    result = SecureTransport.NIF.echo_process(payload, buf_size)
    {:ok, :pong, result}
  end

  defp handle_data(%__MODULE__{payload: payload, flags: flags}, buf_size) do
    compressed = Bitwise.band(flags, 0x01) == 1
    data = if compressed, do: SecureTransport.NIF.decompress(payload, buf_size), else: payload
    {:ok, :data, data}
  end

  defp handle_control(%__MODULE__{payload: payload}, buf_size) do
    result = SecureTransport.NIF.control_dispatch(payload, buf_size)
    {:ok, :control, result}
  end

  defp handle_generic(%__MODULE__{payload: payload}, buf_size) do
    result = SecureTransport.NIF.generic_process(payload, buf_size)
    {:ok, :generic, result}
  end
end
